items.name: Mode
items.summary: Control in the different modes by which a source file can be parsed.

items.name: parse

items.summary: Parse the given Python source code using the specified [`ParseOptions`].

items.name: parse_cells_unchecked
items.signature: fn parse_cells_unchecked(source: &str, ranges: impl IntoIterator<Item = ruff_text_size::TextRange>, options: &ParseOptions) -> Parsed<ruff_python_ast::ModModule>
items.summary: Parses each `range` of `source` as an independent module and concatenates the results into a single [`Parsed<ModModule>`] whose nodes keep their offsets into `source`.

items.name: parse_expression_range
items.summary: Parses a Python expression for the given range in the source.

items.name: parse_module
items.summary: Parse a full Python module usually consisting of multiple lines.

items.name: parse_parenthesized_expression_range
items.summary: Parses a Python expression as if it is parenthesized.

items.name: parse_string_annotation
items.summary: Parses a Python expression from a string annotation.

items.name: parse_unchecked
items.summary: Parse the given Python source code using the specified [`ParseOptions`].

items.name: parse_unchecked_source
items.summary: Parse the given Python source code using the specified [`PySourceType`].

items.name: ModeParseError
items.summary: Returned when a given mode is not valid.

methods.name: as_result
methods.summary: Returns the [`Parsed`] output as a [`Result`], returning [`Ok`] if it has no syntax errors, or [`Err`] containing the first [`ParseError`] encountered.

methods.name: errors
methods.summary: Returns a list of syntax errors found during parsing.

methods.name: expr
methods.summary: Returns the expression contained in this parsed output.

methods.name: has_invalid_syntax
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the parsed source code is invalid i.e., it has [`ParseError`]s.

methods.name: has_no_syntax_errors
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the parsed source code does not contain any [`ParseError`]s *or* [`UnsupportedSyntaxError`]s.

methods.name: has_syntax_errors
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the parsed source code contains any [`ParseError`]s *or* [`UnsupportedSyntaxError`]s.

methods.name: has_valid_syntax
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the parsed source code is valid i.e., it has no [`ParseError`]s.

methods.name: into_expr
methods.summary: Consumes the [`Parsed`] output and returns the contained [`Expr`].

methods.name: into_suite
methods.summary: Consumes the [`Parsed`] output and returns the module body as a [`Suite`].

methods.name: into_syntax
methods.summary: Consumes the [`Parsed`] output and returns the contained syntax node.

methods.name: suite
methods.summary: Returns the module body contained in this parsed output as a [`Suite`].

methods.name: syntax
methods.summary: Returns the syntax node represented by this parsed output.

methods.name: tokens
methods.summary: Returns all the tokens for the parsed output.

methods.name: try_into_module
methods.summary: Attempts to convert the [`Parsed<Mod>`] into a [`Parsed<ModModule>`].

methods.name: unsupported_syntax_errors
methods.summary: Returns a list of version-related syntax errors found during parsing.

items.name: AsMode
items.summary: A type that can be represented as [Mode].
